comparison_panels.title: MFASS v2: AUROC on the same held-out variants
comparison_panels.source_locator: Pinned result JSON $.metrics.auroc; split-v2.tsv test rows; both prediction TSV id/group/label columns; compare-baseline-v2-vs-dnabert2.json $.denominators
comparison_panels.context: Corrected feature baseline and frozen DNABERT-2 with a train-only logistic head, evaluated on exactly the same 8,324 held-out variants (315 positives; 463 groups).
caveats: Only these two evaluated configurations are compared. This is not a ranking of all MFASS methods or all foundation models.

Inputs differ: the feature baseline uses exon distances and conservation in addition to sequence; the frozen-encoder pipeline uses assay-oriented reference/mutant embeddings. Both fit on the canonical training split.

Bars preserve original full-precision result JSON values. The archived paired-bootstrap file uses rounded prediction TSV scores, producing a small AUROC rounding difference; its intervals are not attached to these bars.
SpliceAI and Pangolin marginal results use different scored subsets and remain outside this panel. Consult their archived paired common-subset comparisons for pairwise claims.
